# Helpdesk Ticket Categories

The 14 Deskwell ticket categories in use since 2025-06-16, and the monthly ticket counts by category that I keep from the Deskwell export. Aggregate counts only: no ticket text, names or individual details.

## Summary

The category list came out of the [[helpdesk-triage-categories]] project. The monthly counts are the evidence base for the hybrid policy papers and the only data my [[diploma-research-project]] may use, as approved by [[harriet-osei]] and [[kasia-wrobel]] on 2026-09-22.

## Why It Matters

This is the one place the hybrid ticket share is recorded: 4% before April 2026, 23% in April, 9% in September. It fed the [[hybrid-review-paper-2026-07]] and is the measure in the hybrid umbrella's outcome (under 5%). It also feeds the self-service debate ([[how-do-we-measure-self-service-resolution]]).

## Key Details

The categories, with September 2026 counts (1,140 tickets in total):

| # | Category | Default queue | Sep 2026 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Pay and payslips | Payroll liaison | 196 |
| 2 | Absence and sickness reporting | HR Shared Services | 118 |
| 3 | Annual leave and holiday | HR Shared Services | 121 |
| 4 | Contracts and changes | HR Shared Services | 84 |
| 5 | Hybrid and flexible working | HR Shared Services | 103 |
| 6 | Recruitment and references | Recruitment and onboarding | 47 |
| 7 | Onboarding and new starters | Recruitment and onboarding | 129 |
| 8 | Leavers | HR Shared Services | 52 |
| 9 | Learning and training | HR Shared Services | 61 |
| 10 | Policies and procedures | HR Shared Services | 38 |
| 11 | Family leave | HR Shared Services | 29 |
| 12 | Pensions and benefits | Payroll liaison | 44 |
| 13 | HR systems access | HR Shared Services | 97 |
| 14 | Employee relations | Employee relations (restricted) | 21 |

Hybrid and flexible working as a share of all tickets, 2026:

| Month | All tickets | Hybrid | Share |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| January to March (average) | 1,070 | 43 | 4% |
| April | 1,310 | 301 | 23% |
| May | 1,150 | 161 | 14% |
| June | 1,090 | 120 | 11% |
| July | 1,060 | 106 | 10% |
| August | 1,170 | 140 | 12% |
| September | 1,140 | 103 | 9% |

- Category 5 was called "Flexible working" until 2026-03-30; the rename did not change what goes in it, so the series is comparable.
- August rose with the v2 announcement on 2026-07-22 and the FAQ v2 on 2026-08-24.
- Onboarding (7) and HR systems access (13) are up since July: peak hiring and Talvento manager self-service.

## Caveats

- Categories are set by the triager; misfiled tickets are corrected in the weekly review but some remain.
- A ticket is not a person: one employee can raise several.
- I do not report any category broken down by site or team below 10 employees, following the survey rule ([[survey-reporting-threshold-decision-2026-06-10]]).

## Source Location

Monthly Deskwell export, People Services shared drive, "Helpdesk reports/Monthly", one spreadsheet per year. My summary table is updated in the first week of each month.
